purpose: An inherited public static by-value Generator preserves distinct lexical and called classes without This. Its object-CV selector dies before current; body/finally have no hidden receiver, while selected Gen/cache/argv survive SEND body A and argv B replacing A, caller-only destructor trace and untouched result sentinel.

<?php
class Stop123S extends Exception {}
class Cache123S {
    function __destruct() {
        global $weakTarget, $weakArgument, $weakCache, $weakFactory;
        echo 'CACHE|', $weakTarget->get() instanceof Generator, '|', $weakArgument->get() === null, '|', $weakFactory->get() === null, '|', $weakCache->get() === $this, '|';
    }
}
class Argument123S {
    function __construct() { global $weakArgument; $weakArgument = WeakReference::create($this); }
    function __destruct() {
        global $weakTarget, $weakCache, $weakFactory, $replacementStop;
        echo 'ARG|', $weakFactory->get() === null, '|', $weakTarget->get() instanceof Generator, '|', $weakCache->get() instanceof Cache123S, '|';
        $probe = new Exception('probe'); $trace = $probe->getTrace();
        echo 'TRACE|', $trace[0]['function'] === '__destruct', '|', $trace[0]['class'] === 'Argument123S', '|', $trace[1]['function'] === 'run123S', '|', !isset($trace[2]), '|';
        unset($trace, $probe); throw $replacementStop;
    }
}
class Factory123S {
    public static function flow() {
        global $bodyStop, $weakFactory, $weakCache;
        echo 'START|', !isset($this), '|', self::class === 'Factory123S', '|', static::class === 'ChildFactory123S', '|', $weakFactory->get() === null, '|';
        $cache = new Cache123S; $weakCache = WeakReference::create($cache);
        try {
            $received = yield $cache; unset($received); unset($cache);
            echo 'BODY|', !isset($this), '|', self::class === 'Factory123S', '|', static::class === 'ChildFactory123S', '|', $weakFactory->get() === null, '|';
            throw $bodyStop;
        } finally {
            global $weakTarget, $weakArgument;
            echo 'FIN|', !isset($this), '|', $weakFactory->get() === null, '|', $weakTarget->get() instanceof Generator, '|', $weakCache->get() instanceof Cache123S, '|', $weakArgument->get() instanceof Argument123S, '|';
        }
    }
    function __destruct() {
        global $weakTarget, $weakFactory;
        echo 'FACTORY|', $weakFactory->get() === $this, '|', $weakTarget->get() instanceof Generator, '|';
        $probe = new Exception('early-probe'); $trace = $probe->getTrace();
        echo 'EARLY-TRACE|', $trace[0]['function'] === '__destruct', '|', $trace[0]['class'] === 'Factory123S', '|', $trace[1]['function'] === 'run123S', '|', !isset($trace[2]), '|';
        unset($trace, $probe);
    }
}
class ChildFactory123S extends Factory123S {}
function argument123S() {
    global $target, $weakTarget, $weakCache, $weakFactory; $target = null;
    echo 'HELD|', $weakFactory->get() === null, '|', $weakTarget->get() instanceof Generator, '|', $weakCache->get() instanceof Cache123S, '|';
    return new Argument123S;
}
function run123S() {
    global $target, $weakTarget, $weakArgument, $weakCache, $weakFactory, $bodyStop, $replacementStop;
    $factory = new ChildFactory123S; $weakFactory = WeakReference::create($factory);
    $target = $factory->flow(); $weakTarget = WeakReference::create($target); unset($factory);
    echo 'EARLY|', $weakFactory->get() === null, '|', $weakTarget->get() instanceof Generator, '|';
    $target->current(); $result = 'sentinel';
    try { $result = $target->send(argument123S()); echo 'BAD-RETURN|'; }
    catch (Stop123S $caught) {
        echo 'CATCH|', $caught === $replacementStop, '|', $caught->getPrevious() === $bodyStop, '|', $bodyStop->getPrevious() === null, '|', $caught->getTrace() === [], '|', $bodyStop->getTrace() === [], '|', $weakTarget->get() === null, '|', $weakArgument->get() === null, '|', $weakCache->get() === null, '|', $weakFactory->get() === null, '|', $result === 'sentinel', '|';
    }
}
$bodyStop = new Stop123S('body'); $replacementStop = new Stop123S('argv'); run123S(); echo 'DONE|';
